domain_context: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在问题分析类作文（Why is this happening?）中，剖析某个社会/科研痛点背后的深层原因（既指出直接表层诱因，又挖出底层的考核激励或结构性根源）。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 原因分析段，或学术评论文章】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想在问题分析类作文（Why is this happening?）中，剖析某个社会/科研痛点背后的深层原因（既指出直接表层诱因，又挖出底层的考核激励或结构性根源）。”。请严格按照 `BP35` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L005`（去机械连接词化：用语义钩子替代 First/Second/Moreover），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: Why do many students copy AI answers directly? First, AI is very easy and fast to use. Second, students are lazy and have too much homework. So they just copy and paste.
structural_constraints: S1 [原因总起句 Dual-Cause Thesis]：The widespread emergence of [Problem X] stems from both immediate technological pressures and deeper institutional incentives.
S2 [第一层：直接操作/技术诱因 Immediate Driver]：At the operational level, [Factor A] lowers the cost of [Behavior], tempting individuals/organizations to [Short-term Action].

S3 [第二层：深层制度/激励根源 Structural Root Cause]：More fundamentally, existing evaluation systems reward [Superficial Metric] rather than [Long-term Quality], creating powerful pressure to prioritize speed over rigor.
S4 [双因叠加后果 Compounding Effect]：When effortless generation meets quantity-driven evaluation, [Problem X] becomes systemic rather than isolated.
target_defects_to_fix: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

domain_context: 托福独立与综合写作：理论基础与工程实践权衡
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人要求补测最新基线模型，或者质疑我们的提升是不是因为参数量更大/训练更久。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 2】假设你正在撰写【顶会 Rebuttal 实验补全与公平性自证段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想回复审稿人要求补测最新基线模型，或者质疑我们的提升是不是因为参数量更大/训练更久。”。请按 `BP47` 的句子角色分工，先列出每句的主语核心词与谓语强动词，再连缀成完整段落。

S2 [对比最新基线结果 Performance vs. New Baselines]：Across all four horizons on [Datasets], our method outperforms [New Baseline X] by an average of [9.8%] in MSE and [New Baseline Y] by [12.1%].

S3 [打消参数量/算力质疑 Parameter & FLOPs Parity Proof]：Regarding model capacity, even when we scale down our hidden dimension from $d=256$ to $d=128$ (`Ours-Small`, using 38% fewer parameters and 52% fewer FLOPs than [Baseline X]), `Ours-Small` still outperforms [Baseline X] by [7.4%].
S4 [结论锁定 Conclusion]：These results confirm that our improvements derive from inductive bias rather than increased parameter count.

domain_context: 具身智能视觉运动策略与仿真到真实迁移
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在议论文中回应反方观点（Some people argue that...）：先大度承认反方担忧在短期或局部确实存在，再用结构性证据或制度设计证明该问题完全可控，从而锁死我方立场。
prompt_zh: 【深度病段修改诊所 3：专治口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）】下方议论/分析段落使用了烂大街的万能模板句且缺乏具象实例支撑。请砍掉全部套话外壳，并运用 `L021`（一句话具象行业微观案例法）重写该段。
source_material_or_draft: In this subsection, we introduce the Phase-Aware Attention. The formula is Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d) + M)V. Here M is a phase matrix. It makes the model work better.
structural_constraints: S1 [呈现反方最有力的担忧 Articulate Opposing Concern]：Admittedly, critics raise a valid concern that [Opposing Argument, e.g., automation displaces entry-level clerical and manufacturing workers].
S2 [承认局部真实性 Acknowledge Partial Validity]：In the short term, rapid deployment of [Technology/Policy] can indeed create transitional friction for workers whose routines are easily codified.
S3 [釜底抽薪式转折 Structural Pivot]：However, viewing [X] purely as a zero-sum threat overlooks how productivity gains generate entirely new categories of skilled employment.

S4 [历史/现实反证与制度补救 Evidence & Mitigation]：Just as spreadsheet software reduced manual bookkeeping while expanding demand for financial analysts, pairing automation with targeted vocational retraining allows displaced workers to transition into system supervision and maintenance roles.
target_defects_to_fix: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）

prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：Statement_of_Purpose 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT11 (人工智能方向博士/访问学者申请个人陈述（SoP 全文：从时间序列与生成模型迈向具身智能世界模型）)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP48 -> BP03 -> BP04`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: Why do many students copy AI answers directly? First, AI is very easy and fast to use. Second, students are lazy and have too much homework. So they just copy and paste.
structural_constraints: S1 [原因总起句 Dual-Cause Thesis]：The widespread emergence of [Problem X] stems from both immediate technological pressures and deeper institutional incentives.
S2 [第一层：直接操作/技术诱因 Immediate Driver]：At the operational level, [Factor A] lowers the cost of [Behavior], tempting individuals/organizations to [Short-term Action].

S3 [第二层：深层制度/激励根源 Structural Root Cause]：More fundamentally, existing evaluation systems reward [Superficial Metric] rather than [Long-term Quality], creating powerful pressure to prioritize speed over rigor.
S4 [双因叠加后果 Compounding Effect]：When effortless generation meets quantity-driven evaluation, [Problem X] becomes systemic rather than isolated.
target_defects_to_fix: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 让步反驳段（Body Paragraph 2 or 3）
domain_context: 具身智能视觉运动策略与仿真到真实迁移
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在议论文中回应反方观点（Some people argue that...）：先大度承认反方担忧在短期或局部确实存在，再用结构性证据或制度设计证明该问题完全可控，从而锁死我方立场。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP36` 与全文样板 `FT11` 的后半部分（`BP15 -> BP16 -> BP24`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: In this subsection, we introduce the Phase-Aware Attention. The formula is Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d) + M)V. Here M is a phase matrix. It makes the model work better.
structural_constraints: S1 [呈现反方最有力的担忧 Articulate Opposing Concern]：Admittedly, critics raise a valid concern that [Opposing Argument, e.g., automation displaces entry-level clerical and manufacturing workers].
S2 [承认局部真实性 Acknowledge Partial Validity]：In the short term, rapid deployment of [Technology/Policy] can indeed create transitional friction for workers whose routines are easily codified.
S3 [釜底抽薪式转折 Structural Pivot]：However, viewing [X] purely as a zero-sum threat overlooks how productivity gains generate entirely new categories of skilled employment.

S4 [历史/现实反证与制度补救 Evidence & Mitigation]：Just as spreadsheet software reduced manual bookkeeping while expanding demand for financial analysts, pairing automation with targeted vocational retraining allows displaced workers to transition into system supervision and maintenance roles.
target_defects_to_fix: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）

消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
